auc_ci: unavailable — per-molecule P0–P5 scores were not archived
ef_ci_method: Clopper–Pearson 95% CI on the published hits@1% counts, converted to EF by dividing by prevalence 469/5159. This is not a bootstrap of docking ranks. EF@5% intervals use k reconstructed as round(EF_published × n_5% × prevalence) and are labeled as such. AUC confidence intervals cannot be recovered from counts.
random_hits_1pct_source: P2/P5/P4 taken from published EF@1% (0.21 → 1/52; 0 → 0/n). P0 uses the published 1.90 matching True (9/52). P1/P3 k reconstructed from published Random EF@1%.
